translation: Thirteen: I rubbed until the end of the year, but behind the head I still never saw it disperse. I thought that since the six yang channels all meet at Dazhui, its accumulation is very thick; perhaps it was covered by it, or the wrist was not open. So I first rubbed the wrist, then rubbed Dazhui. The accumulation was thick and took considerable searching; when I saw the bone, I rubbed it for a long time, and the bone joint suddenly rose up, surged and went upward, as if shedding its shell.
